title: Keep rejected producer reports and match criteria tolerantly
summary: When the producer self-check in run.rs fails a job (unmet criteria or missing full test run), the redacted report that triggered it is kept in the job's records. Criterion matching is loosened to ignore numbering, kind tags, case, whitespace and trailing punctuation, so producers that did the work are not failed on wording. The audience is the maintainer diagnosing failed jobs such as k2ej and 5qem.

defaults_applied.how: Unit tests for matching and for report persistence; clippy and fmt clean.
Persist the evidence and fix the matching, not only the two jobs.
The kept report is redacted first.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Cause is unknown from the records; the exact-text match in unmet_criteria (run.rs) is the likely brittle point, so the change both records the report and loosens the match while staying strict about missing or unmet criteria.
The report is stored as a file in the job directory (or an existing record field) rather than a new record schema.
The send-back wording stays; only matching and persistence change.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the self-check fails a job, both on the final send-back and on the first, the redacted producer report (summary, checks_run, criteria_check with statuses and evidence) is written under the job's directory or records, and the failure reason names where it is. Run cargo test to check a test that fails a job through a fake producer and finds the report.

A report whose criteria_check entry differs from the accepted criterion only by a leading number, a [content]/[behavior] kind tag, letter case, surrounding or repeated whitespace, or trailing punctuation counts as reporting that criterion; cargo test has unit tests for unmet_criteria covering each variant.
A criterion absent from criteria_check, or reported with a status other than met, is still listed as unmet, and a different criterion with similar words is not matched; unit tests show it.
A plain criterion such as 'cargo test passes' reported as met with evidence is not failed by the check, shown in a test.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and cargo test pass for the workspace.
The kept report goes through the redactor and holds no secrets or personal data.

out_of_scope: Re-running or repairing jobs k2ej and 5qem
Changing the full-test-run requirement or the number of send-backs
departures: Slightly higher cost than the reference because the root cause is uncertain and persistence needs tests.
